name: lawdb
description: LawDB.ca - Canadian lawyer directory (static site + Cloudflare Worker API + D1 database)

scripts.check: node --check src/worker.js && node --check scripts/build-seed.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run db:seed:build && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=db/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run db:seed:build && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=db/seed.sql
